questions.question: -----------is the incorporation of trace element into mineral structure during solid solution formation and recrystallization of minerals.

explanations.a: Occurs after main precipitation and not during recrystallization.
explanations.b: Adsorption involves surface interaction, not structural incorporation.
explanations.c: Nucleation is the initiation step, unrelated to trace incorporation.
explanations.d: Correct: Co-precipitation includes incorporation of impurities into crystal structure.

questions.question: ------------is a term used to describe the effect on a solution of two dissolved solutes that contain the same ion or ions.

explanations.a: Phase effect refers to phase boundaries, not ion concentration.
explanations.c: Correct: Common ion effect impacts solubility of compounds with shared ions.
explanations.d: Salt effect involves ionic strength, not necessarily common ions.
